description: Defines the DateTimeFieldItemList class for handling datetime field configurations in Drupal, including default value forms, validation, processing, and related constants.

classes.name: DateTimeFieldItemList
classes.description: Represents a configurable entity datetime field with methods for default value handling, validation, and processing.

methods.name: defaultValuesForm
methods.description: Builds the form for setting default date values, either current or relative.

methods.name: defaultValuesFormValidate
methods.description: Validates the relative date input using strtotime.

methods.name: defaultValuesFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for default date values.

methods.name: processDefaultValue
methods.description: Processes and formats the default date value based on field settings.
